answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding one identity to one manufacturer-issued endorsement key inside a secure enclave. Each epoch a zephyr challenge is signed by that chip and checked against a trellis of registered keys; duplicates are rejected, so extra identities need distinct chips. A prism of two independent verifiers re-checks quotes to catch replay. Assuming one unforgeable key per physical unit, with per-identity reward R and per-chip cost C the attacker's total gain is n(R-C), deterring only while R<C; a rich attacker can still buy many chips.
